title: Output Mapping Preserves the Initial Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with initial state $q_0$, and let $f$ be a partial symbol map. For every input word $x$, mapping the output symbols of the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$ by $f$ gives the same configuration as the initial configuration of the machine whose transition outputs are mapped by $f$.
